lineMarkerWidth.$description: Width of the inline-start bar marking a highlighted, added or removed line.

lineHeight.$description: Code line height. Mirrors the A1 Code block (currently a literal in code.css) so the live editor's text and highlight layers align with Code.

hueWeight.$description: Share of a syntax colour's lightness taken from its palette hue; the rest comes from the default text colour. 0.3 keeps every hued role at 4.5:1 or more on code surfaces in all Labs themes and modes except Fresh dark, where default text itself is 4.96:1.

mutedWeight.$description: Share of muted text in comments and punctuation; the rest is default text. 0.75 is the smallest step that clears 4.5:1 on panel and raised surfaces in every Labs theme and mode.

selectionStrength.$description: Live editor: opacity of the action colour behind selected text, so the highlighted text stays visible through the selection.

separatedLineHeight.$description: Separated line spacing: distance between the rows of one wrapped line (20px), tighter than Code's default 22.4px so a wrapped line reads as one unit.

separatedLineGap.$description: Separated line spacing: extra space between logical lines, so lines are 28px apart (20px line height + 8px).

emphasisWeight.$description: Weight that carries keywords, tags and selectors in the Monochrome palette, where colour is not used.
